proposals.evidence: DEDR131 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam aṇṇan, Kannada aṇṇa/aṇa, Kodagu aṇṇë, Tulu aṇṇe and Konda ana/anasi elder brother. These complete survey forms match that kinship family, retaining final vowels and the Konda relational ending. Nursery-word similarity and the cited Prakrit comparison limit claims about the precise transmission history; compounds and unrelated brother terms are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2194 explicitly gives Konda kōnza red-faced monkey with Kui/Kuwi kōnja. Survey konja is a close same-language affricate/length variant; preserve the generic elicitation gloss without imposing a species distinction. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4004 gives Tamil/Malayalam paḻam ripe fruit, Irula pammu/pāmu, Toda pum, Kannada paṇṇu, Parji pal, Gondi paṇḍ(i) and Konda paṇḍu. Selected survey paḷam/payam/pagam/paśam/pām- responses preserve lect-specific reflexes or loss of the medial retroflex, and Kannada/related annu reflects loss of initial h-. These are comparative family proposals; the separate Indo-Aryan-looking phal forms and opaque responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1459 documents kāy/kāya green or unripe fruit throughout southern Dravidian and neighbouring Gondi kāyā fruit. Konda kāya is a comparative extension of that fruit stem; its survey generic fruit sense is retained and the evidence does not by itself establish borrowing direction. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
